title: Portuguese Bean Fritters
description: A delicious and crunchy Portuguese-inspired fritter recipe made with bean and mung bean sprouts. Perfect as a snack or side dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, mash black beans using a fork or a potato masher.
Add flour, onion, garlic, cilantro, salt, and pepper to the bowl. Mix well.
Add mung bean sprouts to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the bean mixture into the skillet.
Flatten the mixture slightly with a spatula.
Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the edges start to brown.
Flip the fritters and cook for another 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining bean mixture, adding more oil as needed.
